provenance: paired-pilot coding agent, reference-text-only linguistic labels from pinned original human manifest annotations, frozen before viewing either arm; no new human/audio adjudication. Sentence/turn ambiguity is not forced into continue/separate.
unit: Unique original native final lexical token, weight 1; punctuation/control excluded. Speaker reference requires an unambiguous token midpoint in exactly one reference_available interval and no different-speaker overlap anywhere in token time span. Native token time mapped through actual sent capture ranges, not guessed cut offsets.
boundary_rule: Original adjacent final boundary is continue only when both nearest scorable lexical tokens belong to the same declared coherent unit; separate when different unambiguous reference speakers, or two different declared completed units. Otherwise uncertain, excluded from primary join precision/recall. Within-final coalescing reported separately.

en.note: Opening readiness statement; trailing filler is retained.
Two related sentences treated as one coherent reply, not automatic sentence=turn.

ja.note: Initial question plus unfinished topic; only within-unit final splits can be labelled continue.
Contrast 自分は遠いけど -> 他の家族; interjected acknowledgement is a separate speaker.
Syntactic continuation across annotation gap; later overlapped dialogue not forced into this unit.
Self-correcting question; interruptions remain independent reference speakers.
Theme-park example and elaboration form one coherent thought.
ところが -> あって is an explicit continuation; subsequent topic changes are uncertain.
Incomplete at recording end; do not count a missing sentence ending as product loss.

uncertainty: Text-only small pilot labels, not ground-truth full utterance segmentation or MT quality ratings. English long timing-only intervals and Japanese tagged/unavailable lexical intervals remain unscorable; no reference text is recovered from Soniox output. Natural source audio is never filtered.
